question: Which Indian chess player won the Vergani Cup Chess Tournament in January 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MR Lalith Babu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian Grandmaster** MR lalith babu__ won the Vergani cup chess tournament on the basis of better tie break score after he was tied with three others, including top seed Anton Korobov.**
 
• His other wins came against Indian Woman **GM Mary Ann Gomes, Max Hess (Germany), GM Lorenzo Lodici (Italy) and Amin Tabatatabaei (Iran).**
 
• International Master **Moksh Amit Doshi** was the next best Indian after Lalith Babu and Bharath Subramaniyam, taking 17th place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **About Vergani cup January 2022**

 
 
• Organizer - **Grandischacchi**
 
• Federation -** Italy (ITA)**

• Tournament Director - **G M Pier Luigi Basso**
